newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia opens July-Aug coffee registrations.
newsitem.headline: Colombia opens July-Aug coffee registrations.

text.p: Finance Minister Jose Antonio Ocampo said Colombia was opening "unlimited" coffee registrations for July-August, a period in which the country was expected to export 2.5 million 60-kg bags of coffee.

Ocampo, who spoke after a weekly policy meeting of the National Coffee Growers' Federation, stressed that registrations opening on Wednesday morning for the two-month period would be "without restrictions".
This means that private exporters and the Federation itself were authorised to export all the coffee they could obtain.

Ocampo, who spoke in remarks to reporters, said he was revealing the anticipated July-August export figure in a bid to provide "transparency" to the world markets and "guarantee supply at a moment of high prices".

But Ocampo also insisted that the government, and National Coffee Growers' Federation, anticipated that no more than about 2.5 million 60-kg bags would be available for shipment in July and August. "It's not a lot of coffee," he said.

Hernan Uribe, the federation's deputy general manager, later reiterated earlier official forecasts that Colombia would produce no more than "about 10 million" 60-kg bags during the current coffee year.
